environment.description: Application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The ALB has an AWS WAFv2 WebACL attached with the following rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING rule in COUNT mode (not block), (2) A custom rule group 'corp-input-sanitization' with a single RegexPatternSet rule matching request URI path containing '/admin' returning BLOCK, (3) AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet in BLOCK mode. The ECS task role has a permissions boundary (arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:policy/DataServiceBoundary) that denies s3:* and ssm:GetParameter. CloudWatch Container Insights enabled. The task runs in a private subnet with NAT gateway egress only. SQLite database mounted from EFS with encryption at rest enabled.

config.network: private subnet, NAT gateway egress only
config.monitoring: CloudWatch Container Insights, VPC Flow Logs
